fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that the complainant reported repeated harassment by a neighbour over a personal disagreement near Roja Park Main Street in Coimbatore. The matter was brought to Coimbatore North PS on 2025-06-12, while the incident was placed on 2025-06-08 at approximately 10:50. Babu Selvam reported the matter orally at Coimbatore North PS; the contact number given was 9000000442. Anitha Raman (9000000267) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complaint refers to Logesh Karuppasamy, a person who arranged the contact, reachable on 9000000198. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Gunasekar Anand, using the number 9000000050. The complainant mentioned photographs and CCTV footage. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00078, as the mobile number 9000000050 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Neighbour allegedly used abusive language during a continuing dispute.
fields.Keywords: harassment, neighbour dispute, suspect, CCTV, morning, photograph, mobile number, associate
